$comment: What the storm drill (scripts/flood-drill.ts --phase storm, deploy/tests/storm/run.sh; P20a, issue #68) must reach in latest.json and stations.json: Den Helder (Marsdiep) at the synthetic storm's 23:00Z high, shifted to the drill clock. Measured = astro + surge (83 + 250 = 333 cm NAP), above the NL-4 band 'Stormvloed (> 260cm)' (260 to 345) of registry/thresholds/nl-4.csv. Read by deploy/tests/e2e/storm-check.mjs; checked against the thresholds and against packages/contracts/src/canaries.ts by test/storm-expected.test.ts. 'canary' is CANARY_RENDERINGS: the owner canary (777777.777 and its stored real 777777.75) first, then the withheld one (123456.789, 123456.79).
